name: Data tests per Operator and Type of Test
description: Data tests of each Operator by Type of Test and result, with the mean data rate.
query_sql:
SELECT Operator, Type_of_Test, Test_Result,
  COUNT(*) AS Tests,
  ROUND(AVG(Mean_Data_Rate), 2) AS Avg_Mean_Data_Rate
FROM selected_data
GROUP BY Operator, Type_of_Test, Test_Result
ORDER BY Operator, Type_of_Test, Test_Result
